name: arggon
description: ArggonManager native seam for Claude Code: the arggon MCP tools (tracker + worktree lifecycle), the /arggon:<command> commands, the maker and standards-reviewer subagents (the delivery lead is the main session — see README), the bundled arggon-cli skill, and the hook gates (global git gates; reviewer dispatch backstop). Requires the arggon CLI on PATH (npm i -g arggon-manager) — the MCP server is `arggon mcp`.
